data.one_liner: Provides a Ken Burns panning and zooming animation for images.
data.what_it_does: Wrap an image (or multiple images) with the KenBurns widget to get automatic pan‑and‑zoom effects. The animation duration, scale and looping can be configured.
use_when: You want a simple Ken Burns effect on static images
You need a quick slideshow with cross‑fade and zoom without writing custom animation code
avoid_when: You require fine‑grained control over animation paths or curves
You need to animate non‑image widgets or video content
Performance is critical for large numbers of high‑resolution images
strengths: Very easy to integrate via a single widget
weaknesses: No custom curve or path control
No built‑in support for advanced animation sequencing
